description: Get the views and leads of each of this shop's listings, day by day (the last 30 days unless you set `from` and `to`), with their all-time totals. Returns `range` (`from`, `to`), `listings`, each with its `id`, `external_id`, `title`, `status`, `views_total`, `leads_total` and `daily` figures (`day`, `views`, `leads`), and `next_cursor` for the next page. For the shop's overall totals, use analytics_summary.

cursor.description: Where to continue: the `next_cursor` of the previous page; leave it out for the first page

from.description: The first day of the period to report, in UTC. Leave it out for the 30 days before `to`

limit.description: How many listings to return in this call. Leave it out for a normal-size answer; the server caps a very large number. To go through every listing, call again with `next_cursor` until it comes back null

to.description: The last day of the period to report, in UTC. Left out, today

name: analytics_listings

listings.description: This page of the shop's listings, each with its all-time totals and its daily views and leads over the range

items.description: One listing's figures: its all-time totals and its day-by-day views and leads

daily.description: One entry for every day in the reported range, oldest first, so the list reads as a timeline

items.description: One day's views and leads for the listing

day.description: The day these figures are for, a UTC date written YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-17"; every day of the range is present, quiet days included

leads.description: How many more signed-in buyers opened the seller's contact from it during that UTC day; 0 on a day without any

views.description: How many times its page was viewed during that UTC day; 0 on a day without views, so a run of zeros shows when buyers stopped looking

external_id.description: Your own id for the listing, as set by sync_catalogue or bulk_create_listings, to match these figures to your system; null when it has none

id.description: The listing's id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`); pass it to get_listing to see the listing itself, or update_listing to improve one that gets few views

leads_total.description: Leads since it was listed, all time: how many different signed-in buyers opened the seller's contact

status.description: active: on sale (public once verified). sold: kept on the site, marked sold. hidden: off the site but not deleted; set_listing_status moves a listing between these three. Any other value, such as expired or stale, means eno took the listing off the site

title.description: The listing's headline, to name it when you report its figures to the seller

views_total.description: Views of its page since it was listed, all time, not only in the reported range; compare it with the daily views to see the trend

next_cursor.description: Pass it back as `cursor` to get the next page; null when this was the last page

range.description: The period the daily figures cover, so you can say which days you are reporting on

from.description: The first day the daily figures cover, a UTC date written YYYY-MM-DD; when you left `from` out, 30 days before `to`

to.description: The last day the daily figures cover, a UTC date written YYYY-MM-DD; when you left `to` out, today

title: Get listing analytics by day
